interface.signature: logistic_map(width: int, height: int, x_coords: list[int], y_coords: list[int]) -> list[list[int | None]]

preconditions.description: The width and height of the map must be positive integers.
The number of x coordinates must equal the number of y coordinates.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < width for x in x_coords) and all(0 <= y < height for y in y_coords)
preconditions.description: All supply point coordinates must be within the boundaries of the map.

postconditions.description: If supply points exist, each cell in the result must contain a non-negative integer representing the Manhattan distance to the closest supply point.
postconditions.expression: len(x_coords) > 0 and len(y_coords) > 0 and all(all(isinstance(cell, int) and cell >= 0 for cell in row) for row in result)

postconditions.description: If no supply points exist, all cells in the result must be None.
postconditions.expression: len(x_coords) == 0 and len(y_coords) == 0 and all(cell is None for row in result for cell in row)

postconditions.description: The result must be a two-dimensional array with dimensions matching the map's height and width.
postconditions.expression: len(result) == height and all(len(row) == width for row in result)
